resolution_law: effective_capability = configured_allowlist AND callable_connector_surface AND authenticating_principal_permission AND authority_guard_allows AND repository_policy_allows

lineage.effect: Broadly allowlisted MCP connector tools and common Bash commands for Claude Code without per-call permission prompts.

lineage.effective_rule: Explicit non-main repository content mutation may proceed when all guard conditions hold; direct main mutation and protected cognitive-anchor mutation are denied.

installed_github_principals_observed_202.name: Vercel
installed_github_principals_observed_202.warning: The app being installed with administration:write is not evidence that another connector or agent can obtain or act as its installation principal.

required_agent_procedure: Resolve the requested mutation to a concrete GitHub API authority class.
Trace the PR/commit that configured the agent-side tool allowlist.
Confirm the tool is callable in the current runtime, not merely listed in repository configuration.
Identify the authenticating GitHub App or token principal and verify its permission for that API class.
Apply current authority guards and repository policy before mutation.
For ruleset or branch-protection writes, require repository Administration authority; content:write is insufficient.
After mutation, verify live effect through read-only GitHub endpoints and bind the observation to exact repository state.
